# Academy of Business Studies by Leon Fambeck

> A/L Business Studies tuition in English medium, Sri Lanka, taught by Leon Fambeck.

## What is taught
- The 2027 batch: theory for students sitting the A/L in 2027.
- The 2028 batch: theory for students sitting the A/L in 2028.
- Revision: for students in their exam year.

## Where
Five places: Nugegoda, Kiribathgoda, Gampaha, Leon's own classroom at his home and live online.

## Good to know
- Every student gets Leon's full set of tutes free, from the first day.
- Fees and the timetable are not published. Leon sends the current ones on WhatsApp.
- Enrol or ask a question on WhatsApp: 077 139 6173. Instagram: @bswithleon.
